English: This game track has no loaded audio. Check that its DLC / mod is enabled.

ChineseTraditional: 使用遊戲已載入音樂，不需外部工具
English: Uses loaded game music; no external tools needed

ChineseTraditional: 直播請使用串流；不建立無限錄製工作。
English: Use streaming for live content. Unlimited recording jobs are not created.

ChineseTraditional: 媒體下載失敗；原副本保留。請檢查來源、網路及 yt-dlp／FFmpeg 版本。
English: Media download failed; existing copies were preserved. Check the source, network and yt-dlp / FFmpeg versions.

ChineseTraditional: 下載未產生完整媒體，未變更原副本。
English: The download did not produce complete media. Existing copies were not changed.

ChineseTraditional: 本機來源不提供網路播放清單。
English: Local sources do not provide online playlists.

ChineseTraditional: 找不到已匯入的本機音訊，請重新匯入。
English: Imported local audio was not found. Import it again.

ChineseTraditional: 歌單預覽已失效，請重新讀取；原清單已保留。
English: The playlist preview expired. Read it again; the original playlist was preserved.
This is not a YouTube track.

ChineseTraditional: 請先完成下載，或改選串流播放。
English: Finish downloading first, or select streaming.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 串流請在設定切換為 mpv 播放後端。
English: Select the mpv backend in Settings for YouTube streaming.

ChineseTraditional: 請在設定指定 yt-dlp.exe，再重試歌單匯入。
English: Set the yt-dlp.exe path in Settings, then retry playlist import.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 歌單查詢逾時，請稍後重試；原清單已保留。
English: YouTube playlist lookup timed out. Try again later; the original playlist was preserved.

ChineseTraditional: 無法啟動 yt-dlp，請檢查工具路徑。
English: Could not start yt-dlp. Check the tool path.

ChineseTraditional: 無法讀取 YouTube 歌單，請確認連結可直接存取及網路正常；原清單已保留。
English: Could not read the YouTube playlist. Check public access and your network; the original playlist was preserved.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 回傳的歌單識別或內容不完整，原清單已保留。
English: YouTube returned incomplete playlist identification or content. The original playlist was preserved.

ChineseTraditional: 此歌單需要登入或受到存取限制，本版只讀取可直接存取的歌單。
English: This playlist requires login or has access restrictions. Only directly accessible playlists are supported.

ChineseTraditional: 已讀取完整歌單，播放時才取得音訊串流。
English: The full playlist was read. Audio streams are obtained only when played.

ChineseTraditional: 歌單有隱藏／無法取得的項目、來源警告或超過 10000 首上限；可加入已讀取歌曲，保留原有項目與順序。
English: The playlist contains hidden / unavailable entries, source warnings, or exceeds 10,000 tracks. Retrieved tracks may be added; existing entries and order will be preserved.

ChineseTraditional: 請在設定指定 yt-dlp.exe，再重試 YouTube 播放。
English: Set the yt-dlp.exe path in Settings, then retry YouTube playback.

ChineseTraditional: 找不到設定的 JavaScript 執行檔，請修正 JavaScript 工具路徑。
English: The configured JavaScript executable was not found. Correct the JavaScript runtime path.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 解析逾時，請檢查網路後重試。
English: YouTube resolution timed out. Check your network and try again.

ChineseTraditional: 此 YouTube 內容需要登入或受到存取限制，本版不讀取 Cookie 或繞過限制。
English: This YouTube content requires login or has access restrictions. Cookies and restriction bypasses are not used.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 未提供可播放的公開音訊，請檢查網址、網路，以及 yt-dlp／JavaScript 工具版本後重試。
English: YouTube supplied no playable public audio. Check the URL, network and yt-dlp / JavaScript runtime versions, then try again.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 工具回傳的歌曲資訊不完整，請更新工具後重試。
English: The YouTube tool returned incomplete track information. Update it and try again.

ChineseTraditional: 解析結果與要求的 YouTube 曲目不一致。
English: The resolved YouTube track does not match the requested track.

ChineseTraditional: 此直播／首播尚未開始，請開始後重試。
English: This live stream / premiere has not started. Try again after it begins.

ChineseTraditional: 此 YouTube 內容不是可直接存取的公開音訊。
English: This YouTube content is not directly accessible public audio.

ChineseTraditional: 來源未提供支援的獨立音訊串流。
English: The source provides no supported separate audio stream.

ChineseTraditional: 字幕來源網址不受支援。
來源未提供所選畫質的影片。
English: The source provides no video for the selected quality.
The source has no media location.

ChineseTraditional: YouTube 工具未回傳支援的媒體位址。
English: The YouTube tool returned no supported media location.

ChineseTraditional: 由遊戲已載入的音樂定義提供，不下載、不匯出或刪除遊戲資產。
English: Uses loaded game music definitions. Game assets are not downloaded, exported or deleted.

ChineseTraditional: 來源已保存；從媒體選項選擇串流／下載、音樂／影片、畫質及字幕。
English: Source saved. Use media options to choose streaming / download, audio / video, quality and captions.

ChineseTraditional: 音樂庫副本可離線使用；刪除副本不影響原始匯入檔案。
English: Library copies work offline. Deleting a copy does not affect the original imported file.

ChineseTraditional: 音樂庫或曲目已變更，請重新開啟。
English: The library or track changed. Open this window again.

ChineseTraditional: 按下新的組合鍵。Esc 取消，Backspace 清除。\n請避開遊戲及其他模組的快捷鍵。
English: Press a new key combination. Esc cancels; Backspace clears.\nAvoid shortcuts used by the game or other mods.

ChineseTraditional: 此組合鍵已被 RimTube 的其他操作使用。
English: This combination is already assigned to another RimTube action.

ChineseTraditional: 目錄更新失敗，保留上次結果；可按重新整理。
English: Catalog update failed. Previous results were kept; try refreshing.

ChineseTraditional: 容量統計失敗，可重新整理
找不到 {0}，請設定工具完整路徑。
English: Could not find {0}. Set the full tool path.

ChineseTraditional: {0} 無法啟動或檢查逾時，請確認工具路徑。
English: {0} could not start or timed out. Check the tool path.

ChineseTraditional: 請在設定指定 {0} 的完整路徑。
English: In Settings, specify the full path to {0}.

ChineseTraditional: 來源 {0} 首；新增 {1}，移除 {2}，順序{3}。\n移除只影響清單，不刪除音訊。重複影片合併為同一曲目。
English: Source: {0} tracks; added: {1}; removed: {2}; order: {3}.\nRemoving entries keeps audio files. Duplicate videos share one track.

ChineseTraditional: {0} 首，同時最多 {1} 首；之後優先本機副本，不打斷目前播放。可在匯入工作調整平行數、取消／重試。
English: {0} tracks, up to {1} downloads at once. Saved copies will be preferred. Adjust concurrency, cancel or retry in Import Jobs.

ChineseTraditional: 畫質上限：{0}p（來源沒有時選擇較低畫質）
English: Quality limit: {0}p (uses lower quality when unavailable)

ChineseTraditional: 新增 {0} 首、已保存略過 {1} 首、已排程 {2} 首；之後優先本機副本。
English: Added: {0}; already saved: {1}; queued: {2}. Saved copies will be preferred.

ChineseTraditional: 平行下載：{0} 首（已有副本會略過）
串流前向緩衝：{0} MiB；返回緩衝：{1} MiB
English: Stream forward buffer: {0} MiB; back buffer: {1} MiB

ChineseTraditional: 已依來源更新 · {0} 首音訊未載入
English: Updated by source · {0} audio tracks not loaded

ChineseTraditional: 更新檔的授權告示缺漏或大小異常，已保留原本工具。
English: Update notices are missing or invalid. The current tool is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 更新檔超過允許大小，已保留原本工具。
English: The update exceeds the size limit. The current tool is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 更新檔雜湊驗證失敗，已保留原本工具。
English: Update checksum verification failed. The current tool is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 更新工具版本與官方發行版本不符，已保留原本工具。
English: The executable version differs from the official release. The current tool is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 已有的更新檔已損壞，請先回復隨包版本。
English: An existing update is damaged. Restore the bundled version first.

ChineseTraditional: 無法驗證官方穩定版本資訊，已保留原本工具。
English: Could not validate the official stable release. The current tool is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 解析核心設定已套用；自訂工具路徑仍優先。
English: Resolver selection applied. Custom tool overrides still take priority.

ChineseTraditional: 請先停止播放，並等候解析、下載與工具檢查完成。
English: Stop playback and wait for resolution, downloads and tool checks to finish first.

ChineseTraditional: 正在回復隨包解析核心…
正在下載並驗證官方解析核心與授權告示…
English: Downloading and verifying the official resolver and license notices…

ChineseTraditional: 解析核心已準備好，停止播放後會自動套用。
English: Resolver is ready and will apply when playback stops.

ChineseTraditional: 更新已取消，原本工具設定保留。
English: Update cancelled. The current tool selection is unchanged.

ChineseTraditional: 只在按下更新時連線到官方 GitHub。新版保存在遊戲使用者資料夾，驗證成功才切換；不覆寫工作坊檔案。自訂 yt-dlp 路徑仍優先，清空後可使用自動選擇。
English: Connects to official GitHub only when requested. Updates are saved in the game user-data folder and activated after verification, without overwriting Workshop files. A custom yt-dlp path takes priority; clear it to use automatic selection.
